trait.name: Chthonic Resistance
trait.description: You have 50 percent resistance to necrotic damage.

trait.name: Chill Touch
trait.description: At character level 1, know Chill Touch and cast it at will.

trait.name: False Life
trait.description: At character level 3, always have False Life available. Cast it once without using a spell slot per Long Rest, and also with appropriate spell slots.

trait.name: Ray Of Enfeeblement
trait.description: At character level 5, always have Ray Of Enfeeblement available. Cast it once without using a spell slot per Long Rest, and also with appropriate spell slots.
